messages.content: How many letters are in the word 'strawberry'? Just the number.
How many letters are in the word 'str​aw​berry'? Just the number.
How many r's are in the word 'strawbеrry'? Answer with just the number.
Give an English word that has exactly 7 letters, starts with 's', ends with 'y', and whose 3rd letter is 'r'. Output just the word.
Give an English word that has exactly 7 letters, starts with 's', ends with 'y', and whose 3rd letter is 'r'. Output just the word.
How many letters (not counting the hyphen) are in 'seventy-seven'? And in 'one hundred and eleven' (not counting spaces)? Just the two numbers.
Write a haiku about tokenizers, then under each line write its syllable count in parentheses.
How many letters are in 'incomprehensibilities'? Just the number.
How many words are in 'a state-of-the-art, well-known e-mail client'? Give the count under two conventions: hyphenated compounds as one word, and as separate words.

Which of these words contain at least one doubled letter (two identical letters adjacent)? necessary, accommodate, occurrence, harass, embarrass, recommend, millennium, parallel, tomorrow, misspell, vacuum, skiing. Output only the ones that do, comma-separated.
Which of these are misspelled? definately, seperate, occurence, accomodate, recieve, wierd, mispell, publically, liase, supercede. Output the misspelled ones with corrections, one per line.
List every 4-letter word in this sentence, in order: 'When they went back home, each cook made some warm soup from five tiny beans.' Output comma-separated only.
List 30 distinct English words containing the letter sequence 'ough', one per line, nothing else.
Generate 10 distinct 7-letter palindromic strings made of lowercase letters (they need not be real words). One per line, nothing else.
Which is larger, 9.11 or 9.9? And how many digits are in the product 1000000 * 1000000? Just the two answers.
Which word in this sentence has the most letters, and how many? 'The archaeologist painstakingly catalogued extraordinary prehistoric artifacts.' Just word and number.
In the string 'the quick brown fox', what is the character at index 10 (0-based) and at index 10 (1-based)? Just the two characters.
How many vowels (a, e, i, o, u) are in 'onomatopoeia'? And how many consonants? Just the two numbers.
